{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c '
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# R04: invalidate_many - correct expectations
c6 = TaggedCache(4)
c6.put("a", 1, ["x"])
c6.put("b", 2, ["x","y"])
c6.put("c", 3, ["y"])
c6.put("d", 4, ["z"])
# mode=any: union of entries with x OR z => a(x), b(x), d(z) = 3
removed = c6.invalidate_many(["x","z"], mode="any")
assert removed == 3, f"Expected 3, got {removed}"
assert len(c6) == 1
print("PASS: invalidate_many any mode")

# mode=all: entries with BOTH x AND y => only a
removed2 = c6.invalidate_many(["x","y"], mode="all")
assert removed2 == 0  # a already gone, b has x but not y
print("PASS: invalidate_many all mode (no match)")

# Fresh test for all mode
c7 = TaggedCache(3)
c7.put("a", 1, ["x","y"])
c7.put("b", 2, ["x"])
c7.put("c", 3, ["y"])
removed = c7.invalidate_many(["x","y"], mode="all")
assert removed == 1, f"Expected 1, got {removed}"
assert len(c7) == 2
print("PASS: invalidate_many all mode")

# Empty tags
c8 = TaggedCache(3)
c8.put("a", 1, ["x"])
assert c8.invalidate_many([]) == 0
assert len(c8) == 1
print("PASS: empty tags removes zero")

# Invalid mode
c9 = TaggedCache(3)
try:
    c9.invalidate_many(["x"], mode="invalid")
    print("FAIL: invalid mode accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: invalid mode rejected")

# R05: resize
c10 = TaggedCache(3)
c10.put("a", 1, ["x"])
c10.put("b", 2, ["y"])
c10.put("c", 3, ["z"])
c10.resize(2)
assert c10.maxsize == 2
assert len(c10) == 2
print("PASS: resize down")

c10.resize(5)
assert c10.maxsize == 5
assert len(c10) == 2
print("PASS: resize up")

# Invalid resize preserves state
try:
    c10.resize(0)
except ValueError:
    pass
assert c10.maxsize == 5
assert len(c10) == 2
print("PASS: invalid resize preserves state")

# R06: Tags as generators
c11 = TaggedCache(3)
c11.put("a", 1, tags=(t for t in ["x","y"]))
assert c11.get("a") == 1
print("PASS: tags as generator")

# R07: TTL
now = [0]
c12 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: now[0])
c12.put("a", 1, ttl=2)
assert c12.get("a") == 1
now[0] = 2
try:
    c12.get("a")
    print("FAIL: expired key not raised")
except KeyError:
    print("PASS: TTL expiry at boundary")

# TTL=0 immediately expired
c13 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: 0)
c13.put("a", 1, ttl=0)
assert len(c13) == 0
print("PASS: TTL=0 immediately expired")

# Invalid TTL
try:
    c13.put("a", 1, ttl=-1)
    print("FAIL: negative TTL accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: negative TTL rejected")

try:
    c13.put("a", 1, ttl=True)
    print("FAIL: bool TTL accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: bool TTL rejected")

try:
    c13.put("a", 1, ttl=float("inf"))
    print("FAIL: inf TTL accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: inf TTL rejected")

# R08: Expired entries removed before operations
now2 = [0]
c14 = TaggedCache(3, timer=lambda: now2[0])
c14.put("a", 1, ["x"], ttl=1)
c14.put("b", 2, ["y"], ttl=2)
now2[0] = 1
assert len(c14) == 1, f"Expected 1, got {len(c14)}"
print("PASS: len only counts live entries")

c14.put("c", 3, ["z"], ttl=10)
assert len(c14) == 2
print("PASS: put expires old entries")

assert c14.invalidate("x") == 0
assert c14.invalidate("y") == 1
print("PASS: invalidate counts only live entries")

# Overwriting replaces expiry
c15 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: 0)
c15.put("a", 1, ttl=10)
c15.put("a", 2, ttl=1)
now2[0] = 1
try:
    c15.get("a")
    print("FAIL: replaced entry not expired")
except KeyError:
    print("PASS: overwrite replaces expiry")

# Invalid TTL leaves state unchanged
c16 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: 0)
c16.put("a", 1, ttl=10)
try:
    c16.put("a", 2, ttl=-1)
except ValueError:
    pass
assert c16.get("a") == 1
print("PASS: invalid TTL leaves state unchanged")

# Deep copy on get
c17 = TaggedCache(2)
val = {"nested": [1,2,3]}
c17.put("a", val, tags=["x"])
result = c17.get("a")
result["nested"].append(4)
assert c17.get("a")["nested"] == [1,2,3]
print("PASS: deep copy on get")

# Deep copy on put
c18 = TaggedCache(2)
val2 = [1,2,3]
c18.put("a", val2)
val2.append(4)
assert c18.get("a") == [1,2,3]
print("PASS: deep copy on put")

# Reject bare string
c19 = TaggedCache(2)
try:
    c19.put("a", 1, tags="bad")
    print("FAIL: bare string accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: bare string rejected")

# Reject nonstring
c20 = TaggedCache(2)
try:
    c20.put("a", 1, tags=[1,2])
    print("FAIL: non-string tags accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: non-string tags rejected")

# Invalid input leaves state unchanged
c21 = TaggedCache(3)
c21.put("a", 1, tags=["x"])
try:
    c21.put("b", 2, tags="bad")
except ValueError:
    pass
assert c21.get("a") == 1
print("PASS: invalid input leaves state unchanged")

print("\n=== ALL REQUIREMENTS VERIFIED ===")
'
"}
